title: [Accommodation Request API - POST /api/traveler/request-bids] Inverted Stay Dates (checkOutDate Earlier Than checkInDate) Are Accepted and Persisted With HTTP 200 OK
environment: Staging (STAG) · Strapi Backend API & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/accommodation)
test_account: Signed-In QA Traveler Session on Staging (Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_QA_TOKEN>)
steps_to_reproduce: Load the complete valid room-request fixture (fixtures/valid-request-bids.json) where data.checkInDate='2026-12-20' and data.checkOutDate='2026-12-22'.

Single-Variable Mutation: Clone valid-request-bids.json and change ONLY data.checkOutDate from '2026-12-22' to '2026-12-18' (2 days before checkInDate; fixtures/request-bids-inverted-checkout-date.json).
Execute GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/customer-requests readback to check whether an open Customer Request was persisted (then cancel test record #1537).
actual_result:
- POST /api/traveler/request-bids with checkInDate='2026-12-20' and checkOutDate='2026-12-18' returns HTTP 200 OK ({"success": true, "message": "Rating created successfully."}).
- GET /api/customer-requests readback confirms open Customer Request #1537 was persisted in PostgreSQL with checkInDate='2026-12-20' and checkOutDate='2026-12-18'.
expected_result:
- Per Accommodation Route Contract (Confluence 166952975) and GNS-FORM-001 (Confluence 174227515), the backend must enforce checkOutDate strictly after checkInDate (>= 1 night) and reject inverted date ranges with a 4xx validation error (<CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>).
- Zero Customer Request records may be created in the database.

evidence.console: Test Case STAG-API-206 | Single-Variable Delta: data.checkOutDate ('2026-12-22' -> '2026-12-18') | Test record #1537 cancelled after readback.
evidence.network: POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/request-bids (checkInDate='2026-12-20', checkOutDate='2026-12-18') -> HTTP 200 OK; GET /api/customer-requests -> confirmed id=1537 saved.
evidence.notes: Frontend chunk 452btq2-mvhin.js enforces date picker constraints in UI, but POST /api/traveler/request-bids lacks server-side checkOutDate > checkInDate domain validation. | Security Classification: OWASP A06:2025 Insecure Design (CWE-840) & A10:2025 Not Failing Securely (CWE-636) · OWASP API6:2023 | OWASP Remediation: Validate ISO stay dates server-side (checkInDate >= today and checkOutDate > checkInDate) before DB insert (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Input_Validation_Cheat_Sheet.html).

classification: Confirmed Bug — Inverted Stay Window (checkOutDate < checkInDate) Persists Open Customer Request With HTTP 200 OK
reproducibility: Always (100% — single-variable mutation verified with GET readback on STAG)
